EFMA (2000). Best Available Techniques for Pollution Prevention and Control in the European Fertilizer Industry, Booklet No. 6 of 8: Production of Ammonium Nitrate and Calcium Ammonium Nitrate. European Fertilizer Manufacturers' Association, Brussels. No DOI printed.

Locators are printed page numbers (footer numbers; PDF page = printed + 2). Qualitative BAT booklet: the only energy numbers are in Sect. 4.1 (electricity and steam per t of solid AN, AN solution and CAN; steam export up to 170 kg/t). Steam is in kg/t with no pressure, so not converted to GJ. Capex only for pollution-control add-ons (Sect. 2.3.1, 8.3), placed in _measures with EUR-million as printed; price year not stated, 2000 used. No GHG emission numbers (N2O from decomposition discussed qualitatively). BAT emission levels (non-GHG) not loaded. EU region.
